summary.prose: No production contract changes. The Story corrects 23 tests whose expectations are out of date with code that is right. The gate tests get one shared builder of valid code review records, so they satisfy the current freshness rule instead of the rule being relaxed; the inventory, convert-repeat, call-limits, build-record and LMDB tests are each corrected at their own cause.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Fix the known failing tests of the workflow gate, artifact, review-limit and LMDB areas

errorCases.scenario: A rebuilt gate fixture is still incomplete (a missing changedFiles entry for a changeLog file, or a stale fingerprint) so the gate refuses it again
errorCases.detection: the test asserts the specific outcome (completed, withheld, blocked) and fails with the gate's own message, e.g. 'the code review does not cover BUILD file'
errorCases.response: the shared builder derives changedFiles from the BUILD's changeLog and the fingerprint from reviewedBuildFingerprint, so the fixture is valid by construction

errorCases.scenario: The build-record t7 test cannot find a hand-filled record because a record is missing after the repository conversion
errorCases.detection: readFileSync throws ENOENT for the path
errorCases.response: read the lowercase s1 record the conversion produced; if one of the three hashes has no record, say so in the test rather than skipping it

errorCases.scenario: The LMDB behaviour differs between library versions
errorCases.detection: the read throws a different code than the test pins
errorCases.response: the test asserts what the installed library does for each case and states the code observed, so a library upgrade changes the test on purpose

edgeCases.input: The call-limits test runs on a machine whose ~/.insrc/config.json sets designReview limits
edgeCases.expected: the test passes the default settings explicitly and gives the same result on every machine

edgeCases.input: The convert-repeat comparison between an uninterrupted run and a crashed-and-rerun run
edgeCases.expected: equal except for the 'at' timestamps, which the comparison masks

edgeCases.input: The inventory scanner finds a file with an entry that no longer matches, and a file with no entry
edgeCases.expected: the stale entry is corrected or removed and the new file is inventoried with the class and way it writes

No test is skipped, deleted or weakened to make the sweep green

migration.stateBefore: 23 tests fail on the base commit: 20 gate tests write code review records the tightened freshness rule refuses (src/workflow/code-review/build-freshness.ts), and 3 + 3 others are out of date with the code, the repository conversion, the user's config or the installed LMDB library.
migration.stateAfter: All 23 tests pass and describe current behaviour; the freshness rule is unchanged; the gate tests build their review records through one shared builder; no test is skipped or deleted; no production file changes unless a root cause turns out to be a code defect.

migrationSteps.action: Add the shared builder of valid code review records and its own test that the gate still refuses each way of making a record invalid
Move the four gate test files onto the builder, one file at a time, running each file after the change
Correct the artifact write inventory entries for src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts and src/daemon/index.ts after reading what each file does
Make the convert-repeat comparison ignore the clock, the call-limits test use the default settings, and the build-record t7 test read the lowercase s1 records
Make the LMDB lock-loss test assert what the installed library does, stating the code it observes
Run the workflow and db sweeps and compare the failing and skipped counts with the base

migration.backwardCompat: No public API changes; only test files and, if one is found to be a real defect, the named production file.

alternativesConsidered.name: One shared valid-review fixture builder
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: The four gate test files build their code review records through one helper that fills verdict, changedFiles and the BUILD fingerprint from reviewedBuildFingerprint; the other seven tests are fixed in place.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Add a test helper that, given the BUILD record a test writes, produces a code review record whose body carries the verdict, subject.changedFiles covering every changeLog file, and subject.buildFingerprint computed by reviewedBuildFingerprint. The four gate files call it instead of hand-writing CR bodies. The gate code is not touched. The other seven tests are corrected one by one: the inventory entries, the clock-free convert-repeat comparison, the call-limits test using DEFAULT_DESIGN_REVIEW_SETTINGS, the build-record t7 path, and the LMDB expectation.
pros: The gate stays exactly as strict as it is.
One definition of a valid review record, so a future change to the freshness rule is fixed in one place.
Each failure is fixed at its own cause.
cons: The helper must track the freshness rule by calling reviewedBuildFingerprint, so it couples to that function.

alternativesConsidered.name: Edit each gate fixture inline
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add the three missing fields by hand to every CR fixture in the four gate files.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Without a helper, extend each hand-written CR record in the four gate test files with changedFiles and a buildFingerprint computed in place. The other seven tests are fixed as in a1.
cons: The same fixture logic is repeated in about twenty places and drifts when the rule changes again.
Easy to leave one fixture subtly invalid.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Correct but repeats the fixture logic across about twenty tests and drifts when the rule changes.

alternativesConsidered.name: Relax the gate to accept bare reviews
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Make reviewBuildGap accept a review without a fingerprint or changedFiles so the old fixtures pass.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Weaken reviewBuildGap so a missing buildFingerprint or changedFiles is treated as fresh. Rejected by the Story: it removes the 2026-10-24 protection against approving a BUILD with a stale or unbound review.
pros: Smallest edit for the 20 gate tests.
cons: Loosens a safety gate the Story forbids loosening.
Undoes the intent of commits 1ed200db1, e0c3e97d5, d7db76538.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Violates the Story's rule that the gate is not loosened.
